newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - HFS trades higher at 60.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - HFS trades higher at 60.

text.p: HFS Inc rose to 60 in after-hours trading against a close of 58-1/2 on the New York Stock Exchange following news of its merger with CUC International Inc, dealers said Tuesday.
CUC, which broke the news after normal trading hours, went down to 25-1/4 from a close of 26.
The company said the deal it had reached with HFS was worth an estimated $11 billion.
"They're the big ones right now," said one trader, referring to the session's most active stocks.
Meanwhile, Staples Inc and Office Depot saw their stock remain near where they closed during normal trading hours despite the release of new information on their merger plans.
Staples was trading at 21-7/16 near its close of 21-1/2 on the Nasdaq Stock Market, while Office Depot was at 17 against 16-7/8 on the NYSE.
The companies said they had decided to extend their merger deal in anticipation of a court ruling on an injunction by the Federal Trade Commission.
The New York Stock Exchange said Tuesday that session one had a volume of 229,600 shares against 771,000 on Friday. There was no session two, it added.
